rationale: The benchmark is not usable. The evaluator (evaluate.py) rejects the expert golden solution with exit code 1 and prints FAIL markers for all five requirements (FR1-FR4, SR1). The golden run failure is deterministic and repeated. Because the golden run fails, the mutation score of 0.0 is not meaningful. The root cause is an evaluation framework bug: the evaluator either compiles or grades the wrong file, or the testbench instantiation/compilation fails silently, causing all checks to report missing markers. The evaluator must be fixed to correctly locate, compile, and simulate the submission file at submission/recovered_rtl.v, and to produce PASS for the golden solution before any other issues (mutation coverage, metrics) are addressed.
revision_instructions: A Tester repair reproduced the identical golden rejection. Regenerate the Expert golden and case artifacts against the pinned interface; do not weaken the evaluator to accommodate a noncompliant golden.
